title: The Vanilla+ Modpack
description: Just a collection of mods that I use for my game to enhance it while still keeping a vanilla feel and can be used to play on vanilla worlds/servers. Also used for PvP and content creation.
body:
This is the modpack/instance I use when I play Minecraft on servers/with friends, as well as for making videos. It's vanilla friendly, meaning you can play on your favorite Minecrafts servers without running into compatibility issues. It is also generally PvP based, so there are some mods that are used mainly for combat, like Uku's Armor HUD, InventoryHUD, and more! On top of that, it's great for film making, as it comes with mods like Flashback and Picture Mode for cinematic clips and screenshots! Happy Crafting!
